newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim, Lucent in $26 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim, Lucent in $26 mln deal.

text.p: Polish industrial and trading firm Elektrim SA and its telephone subsidiary El-Net awarded Lucent Technologies Poland SA a $26 million contract to supply and service telecom equipment, Elektrim said on Tuesday.

Elektrim said in a statement that the supplies would be a part of a first investment stage in the northern Bydgoszcz province that would allow El-Net to connect more than 40,000 subscribers this year and next, starting this September.
The statement said EL-Net plans to invest about $150 million from this year to 2001 to connect 150,000 subscribers in the Bydgoszcz region. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
